verdict.rationale: Open WebUI has a plugin ecosystem with community sharing, so this axis applies. The pack shows only that plugins run arbitrary Python on the server and that users can run what others share. It contains no evidence of registry scanning or moderation, plugin provenance or signing, or a documented process for handling malicious submissions.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the skills/plugin registry has a security story — scanning or moderation, provenance, and a documented response to malicious submissions
